# Waveshare

[2.13inch e-Paper (D) research](epaper-213-d-2018/characterization.json) covers the preliminary 2018 panel specification. Its update duration is TBD, so energy per refresh remains unknown. These values must not be applied to a current HAT/adapter revision without checking its panel and circuitry. See the [datasheet comparison](../../docs/EINK-DATASHEETS.md).
